name: protsenko-hub
description: Family hub: calendar, shopping, Solomiya tasks, contacts

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @protsenko/shared build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @protsenko/shared build && pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter web exec ng build --configuration=development
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter api exec prisma db seed
